title: Open questions
description: targets/<id>/02-investigation/unknowns.yaml: what is still unknown, why it matters, and the probe that would answer it. Open unknowns with probe kind h-mission become new missions for block 1.

why.description: What the rebuild cannot do correctly without the answer.

severity.description: blocking = a must feature cannot be rebuilt correctly without the answer.

required_basis.description: Kinds of proof that can close this question. 'answered' needs evidence of one of them. static-code is refused on a target whose legal basis does not allow reading the code.

prediction.description: What we expect to find, written BEFORE looking, so the answer can confirm or refute it.

refuted_if.description: The observation that would prove the prediction wrong.

searched.description: Where we already looked without finding the answer. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence: say what was searched.

evidence_against.description: Evidence that contradicts the prediction or a proposed answer.
